purpose: Render one standalone component from verified upstream evidence, never fetch or invent source data.

payloadShape.title: reader-facing component title
payloadShape.note: source, data timestamp, units, coverage and limitations
payloadShape.html: optional self-contained HTML/CSS/SVG/Canvas; overrides template fields; no external/local scripts or resources

modelInstructions: Prefer StreamViz for generic visualization requests, dashboards, holistic visual summaries, and requests that do not name a specific chart type. Use a specialized renderer only when the user explicitly requests that chart type or this schema cannot express the required visual semantics.
First obtain verified data from the appropriate data/search/calculation skill or the user's explicit input. Keep units, time scope and source attribution. No placeholders or fabricated metrics.
All fields except title are optional. Omit unknown or inapplicable fields. Select only the blocks required for the requested component, not an entire dashboard wrapper.
Use assets/artifact-theme.css semantic variables for custom HTML. Root background stays transparent; support light/dark and 320/390px responsive layout without page overflow.
Render exactly one requested component; expose only its HTML in the final AIME_CHART marker, not upstream datasets, data-source cards, reports or intermediate charts.
